# QR Code generator, vendored

Project Nayuki's [QR-Code-generator](https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator) at `3c6d0b3c`, MIT (`LICENSE`).
Copied from Qrer's `assets/vendor/nayuki/qrcodegen.js`: the TypeScript build with an ES module export and Qrer's
function-module mask. Symbol encoding is unchanged. Used by "Share as QR" in `ui/chrome.js`.
